title: Image serverless worker input (image-serverless/v1)
description: RunPod serverless input: a prepared ComfyUI API graph plus application snapshots (parameter, acceleration) and optional input assets (base image, mask, references).

prompt.description: Prepared ComfyUI API graph (node id -> {class_type, inputs}). The worker submits it unchanged; it never builds or edits the graph.

parameter.description: Application snapshot of generation parameters (model, mode, scene_id, seed, width, height, steps, cfg, sampler, scheduler, prompt, negative_prompt, ...). Used for tracing only, never to build the graph or to substitute telemetry facts.

acceleration.description: Application snapshot of acceleration settings (gpu_class, steps, use_turbo, ...). Used for tracing only, never to build the graph.

action.description: Health check without loading a model or running a graph; prompt is not required.

assets.description: Optional input files (edit base image, mask, references) delivered as presigned GET URLs. The worker downloads each file into the ComfyUI input directory under name; the graph references those names in LoadImage/LoadImageMask.

name.description: File name (basename, no path segments); the graph references this name.

sha256.description: Expected sha256 of the file; the worker verifies it and fails the job on mismatch.

kind.description: Advisory input kind: image (base/reference) or mask (edit mask). The worker only validates it; the graph decides how the file is used.

size.description: Expected file size in bytes; the worker verifies the downloaded size.

policy.description: Optional RunPod policy (executionTimeout/ttl). The worker does not read it; RunPod applies it before the handler runs.
